from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
R=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'scripts'));sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'src'))
from phase_admission_protocol import read,ref
import reduce_spatial_context_trial as m
plan=read(m.ROOT/'plan-v1.json');rows,sources=m.earlier_rows(plan)
context=read(plan['baseline_plan']['path'])
history=[context[k] for k in ['V175_scores','matched_scores','local_scores','flat_spatial_scores']]+[plan['baseline_scores'],ref(m.ROOT.parent/'V184-wave-readout-trial-v1/scores-v1.json')]
for b in history:
 old=read(b['path'])
 for method in dict.fromkeys(r['method'] for r in old['rows']):rows+=m.source_rows(b,method,method,plan)
actual=read(history[-1]['path'])
rows += [dict(r,method=m.METHODS[e]) for e in ['raw','EMA'] for r in actual['rows'] if r['method']==m.PRIMARY_BASELINE[e]]
design=read(plan['design']['path'])['observations']
x=m.comparisons(rows,m.ALL_METHODS,[c['id'] for c in design]);text,cells=m.tables(x['summary'],fixture=True)
assert x['methods']==23 and x['metric_rows']==18906 and x['contrasts']==42 and len(cells)==1554
assert all(g['mean_difference']==0 for g in x['groups'] if g['comparison_role'].startswith('matched-support-'))
out=m.ROOT/'full-comparison-fixture-verification-v1.json'
value={k:x[k] for k in ['methods','metric_rows','contrasts','primary_endpoint_contrasts','independent_Decimal_summary_means','paired_mean_and_difference_checks','real_references_scored']}
value.update(status='pass-structural-full-suite-reused-V184-endpoint-standins-not-V185-quality',fixture_only_no_actual_V185_quality=True,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),reducer=ref(R/'scripts/reduce_spatial_context_trial.py'),table_cells=len(cells),all_primary_fixture_differences_exact_zero=True,new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0)
with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('PASS',value['methods'],value['metric_rows'],value['contrasts'],value['table_cells'],value['paired_mean_and_difference_checks'])
